channels.name: Notice to local officials and local media (30 TAC 319.302)
channels.legal_basis: 30 TAC 319.302: the owner of a local government's facility notifies local government officials and local media within 24 hours of a spill likely to affect a drinking-water source, of 50,000 gallons or more near one or in a sensitive area, or of "a spill of 100,000 gallons or more"; 319.303 sets the precautionary statements
channels.note: Every local government's facility in Texas: the notice goes to local government officials and local media by hand delivery, fax, e-mail or telephone, with a copy to the TCEQ regional office within 48 hours, only above the thresholds. No web channel found: nothing requires a posting, and the media decide whether to publish. (https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/texas/30-Tex-Admin-Code-SS-319-302; research/tx/report.md §2.1)
